name: guillezorrilla-skills
description: Agent skills for engineering and productivity — grilling a plan before you build it, TDD, systematic debugging, codebase design, team-convention detection, and frontier-model orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Engineering and productivity skills for teams.
interface.longDescription: Grill a plan before building it, build it test-first, debug it with a tight feedback loop, and design deep modules with a shared vocabulary. setup-team-conventions detects how a team actually works — forge, tracker, branch and commit conventions, the real verify commands, review rules — from git history and CI rather than from documentation, and records it for every other skill to read. efficient-fable orchestrates frontier models and uses Codex as a second executor when it is available, falling back to Claude subagents when it is not.
defaultPrompt: Run setup-team-conventions once in a shared repo before implementing anything, so branch naming, commit format, verify commands and review rules come from this team rather than from defaults
Reproduce a reported bug with the reporter's exact steps before diagnosing it, and say "no bug" when the behaviour is correct rather than proposing a fix
Claim done only with the command and its exit code pasted; committed is not deployed
Fix only what was reported — report unrelated findings instead of absorbing them
Leave commits, pushes and pull requests to the human unless explicitly asked
